title: superhot toggle key: named on the F1 list and beside the Settings row, one honest line, and the second window says when the host flips it
why: His note (2026-10-18, build 30.73, in a raid): "superhot mode needs a toggle key." The key already exists: the key left of 1 (Backquote) has toggled Superhot since v7.23, moves the same dial and the same saved word as the one Settings row, redraws an open Settings row, and on a linked window says SUPERHOT FOLLOWS THE HOST and changes nothing. But no screen named it except CHANGE KEYS, so a new key would only have been a second control for the same job (his rule: one control per job). This build makes the existing key findable and honest: (1) the F1 list has a superhot on/off row on the key left of 1; (2) the pane beside the Settings list names the key under the Superhot row; (3) the line it says is always the state just set: on, off, on within a second used to leave SUPERHOT OFF on the message row and last in the left feed with Superhot on, and a repeat later counted x2, so it now keeps one line; (4) 2-player: Superhot stays the host dial (his v16.74 order, sent in the world word), so only the host window toggles it, the linked window refuses its own press, and now it also says SUPERHOT ON or OFF when the host flips it mid raid.
now: The key left of 1 turns Superhot on and off. It is on the F1 list and beside the Settings row, and the line always shows the state just set.
